posts.title: A Rendering Engine That Happens To Have Text
posts.description: This blog is now a Rust program that simulates a dip pen, a sheet of vellum and a 250-year-old desk, with the words laid over the top.

posts.title: Programmers Aren't People
posts.description: Computer" was a job title for a human being before the machines took the word. "Programmer" is the same kind of word.

posts.title: The Schoolhouse
posts.description: The word for leisure became the word for compulsion, and nobody talks about it.
